verdict.rationale: Docs mention admins can 'audit every action' an AI agent takes as part of agent governance, implying some audit logging exists, but there's no evidence of a general admin audit log covering all user/workspace actions (logins, permission changes, item edits) as a PM would expect for security review. missing for 10: evidence of a comprehensive audit log covering human user actions across the workspace, not just AI agent activity; independent/hands-on confirmation of audit log usability.
